title: Co-extraction of RNA and DNA from plant tissue
author: Dominik Buchner
materials: rpm, Room temperature, 10 minutes, at maximum speed

steps.title: Prepare bead‑filled tube
steps.instruction: For each sample, use a 2 mL screw‑cap tube pre‑filled with approximately 400 mg of 2 mm zirconia beads and 0.1 mm glass beads.

steps.title: Add plant tissue
steps.instruction: Add up to 200 mg of plant tissue (typically 50 mg for most samples) to the prepared tube; lower amounts may improve results for high‑RNA samples.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of GITC lysis buffer to the tube. Optionally add 2‑Mercaptoethanol for complete RNase inactivation (requires fume‑hood handling).

steps.title: Bead‑beat homogenization
steps.instruction: Immediately bead‑beat the tube for 00:05:00 at maximum speed (adjust time if needed) until the material is completely homogenized.

steps.title: Brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at x g, room temperature, for 10 seconds at maximum speed.

steps.title: Transfer crude lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the crude lysate to a pre‑filter column.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the flow‑through from the previous step to a silica spin column (DNA column); keep the flow‑through for later RNA binding.

steps.title: Adjust RNA binding conditions
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL absolute ethanol to the retained flow‑through to adjust conditions for RNA binding to silica.

steps.title: Mix ethanol‑lysate
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture to thoroughly combine lysate and ethanol; do not centrifuge.

steps.title: Load RNA onto silica
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto a second spin column (RNA column), centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature, for 15 seconds and discard the flow‑through; repeat the loading once more to pass the entire volume.

steps.title: RNA wash buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL RNA wash buffer 1 to the RNA spin column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature, for 15 seconds and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash RNA and DNA (step 1)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RNA wash buffer 2 to the RNA column and 500 µL DNA wash buffer 1 to the DNA column, centrifuge at 11 000 rpm, room temperature, for 15 seconds and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash RNA and DNA (step 2)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RNA wash buffer 2 to the RNA column and 500 µL DNA wash buffer 2 to the DNA column, centrifuge at 11 000 rpm, room temperature, for 15 seconds and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry silica membranes
steps.instruction: Spin the spin columns at 11 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 minute to dry the silica membranes, then transfer each column to a fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer directly onto each silica membrane, incubate at room temperature for 00:03:00, then spin at 11 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 minute to collect eluates.

steps.title: Store RNA and DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted RNA at –80 °C and the eluted DNA at –20 °C.
